text:
Breathe in, Tim. Feel your feet on the ground.
You are building work you love, one step at a time.
You know what to do next, and you do it.
Your body is strong. Your mind is clear.
Every step today moves you forward.
You have done hard things before. You can do this.
Keep going. And so it is.

candidates.prompt: Speak slower, warmer and more intimate, as if sitting beside one person late in the evening: close to the microphone, soft and low, unhurried, a gentle smile in the voice. Let each line settle before the next.
Speak like a confident running coach beside one person on a morning run: grounded and encouraging, steady breath, a little brisk, sure of every word, never salesy and never shouting.

candidates.prompt: A warm, grounded man in his forties with a low, slightly husky voice. He speaks calmly and confidently, like a trusted coach, close to the microphone, in a quiet room. No music, no sound effects.
candidates.note: A new voice designed from a description (ByteDance Seed Audio)

candidates.prompt: A deep, gravelly, raspy baritone. An older man in his early sixties with a worn, husky texture from decades of speaking to large crowds. Big chest resonance, slow and deliberate, with intense, warm conviction. Powerful but not shouting. Leans into key words, pauses with purpose, sounds like a seasoned coach who has seen it all.
candidates.note: Designed voice: gravelly, older, experienced coach

candidates.prompt: A deep, gravelly, raspy baritone. An older man in his early sixties with a worn, husky texture from decades of speaking to large crowds. Big chest resonance, slow and deliberate, with intense, warm conviction. Powerful but not shouting. Leans into key words, pauses with purpose, sounds like a seasoned coach who has seen it all. Even more rasp and audible breath in the voice, and a lower pitch.
candidates.note: Designed voice: as P5, more rasp and breath, lower

candidates.prompt: A deep, gravelly, raspy baritone. An older man in his early sixties with a worn, husky texture from decades of speaking to large crowds. Big chest resonance, slow and deliberate, with intense, warm conviction. Powerful but not shouting. Leans into key words, pauses with purpose, sounds like a seasoned coach who has seen it all. More energy and drive: a peak-moment pep talk, urgent and building, still never shouting.
candidates.note: Designed voice: as P5, more energy and drive
